description: Send a fax via Placetel (POST /faxes). The pages come from UPLOADED documents, never from base64 arguments: upload each file first (create_document_upload_url → PUT → finalize_document_upload, or a bridge 'upload_*_to_call_pilot_ai' tool) and pass the document ids. PDFs are taken page by page, JPG/PNG photos each become one A4 page (EXIF rotation respected); all are joined in the given order into ONE fax. Required: to_number (e.g. '030 1234 5678' or '+49 30 12345678'), document_ids (array, in page order). Optional: from_number (your Placetel fax number; default: integration setting fax_number, else the number your last fax used), email (where Placetel sends the transmission report; default: your login address), header. This SENDS immediately to an outside party — confirm recipient number and pages with the human first. Returns the fax id and status 'queued'; check delivery with get_placetel_fax.

from_number.description: Your Placetel fax number; defaults to the integration setting or last used number

name: send_placetel_fax
